ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Order status, Placed and later stages need Order type, Order channel and Order value.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CASE(Stage__c, "Placed", 1, "Confirmed", 2, "Picking", 3, "Shipped", 4, "Delivered and paid", 5, 0) >= 1, OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Order_type__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Order_channel__c)), ISBLANK(Order_value__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Order type, Order channel and Order value before moving to Placed.
